name: Scoped Search
description: A search bar that turns scope tokens like in:docs and from:@mara into removable chips as you type, shows recents on focus and morphs its ⌘K hint into a clear button.

props.name: operators
props.description: Operators the field understands. Each has a key (the word before the colon), a label, a one-line hint and its values ({ id, label, chip?, detail?, meta?, icon?, initials? }). Typing key: opens that operator's values.

props.name: scopes
props.description: Parse scope tokens into chips. On, a finished token (picked from the list, completed with Tab, or followed by a space) becomes a removable chip, one per operator, and the panel offers the operators. Off, in:docs stays plain text and recents show their scopes as text.

props.name: recents
props.description: Show recent searches when the empty field is focused. Off, an empty focused field shows only the Narrow with operators (or nothing when scopes is off too).

props.name: recentSearches
props.description: Recent searches as { id, query, scopes?, when? }. Picking one restores its text and chips and submits it. The demo adds every search you run to the top.

props.name: shortcutHint
props.description: Shows a ⌘K keycap (Ctrl K off Apple platforms) at the right of the empty field and binds that shortcut to focus it. Once there is something to clear, the keycap morphs into the round clear button. Off, the clear button grows out of nothing.

props.name: size
props.description: 48px or 56px tall. Text steps from 16px to 18px, chips from 26px to 30px, suggestion rows from 40px to 44px.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no text and no chips.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black field and panel with white ink, or the white inverse on a pale stage.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the matched letters in suggestions, the caret, the focus halo and the active row's key. Monochrome until you set it.

props.name: defaultScopes
props.description: Chips on first render, as { key, value } pairs.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called whenever the text or the scopes change, with the free text and the parsed scopes.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on Enter, on the Search row, or when a recent search is picked.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, for width or margin in the host layout.
